decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-03fdf64b77d5] states a single concrete change: a backport label for `v2.6.x` was added in fluxcd/flux2 (PR #5379). It names no operator-facing surface (no CRD field, flag, chart value, API or image). That is enough to set the open aspects: the subject is project release tooling (a repository label) and no environment is exposed, which supports the informational, no-consequence reading. Confidence is low because the excerpt does not say outright that the label has no effect on installations; that is inferred from the wording "backport label".
